references.text: Describes the same stream Kana as part of Ephraim's border, showing the connection between the territories of Ephraim and Manasseh.
Continues the description of the borders between Ephraim and Manasseh, noting that Ephraim had cities within Manasseh's territory.
Also mentions cities set apart for the children of Ephraim in the midst of Manasseh's inheritance, corresponding to the description in Joshua 17:9.
Describes the border of Manasseh from Asher to Mikmethath and to Tappuah, providing context for the boundary description in verse 9.
